title: SRA Permanent Transit Camp / Rental Housing
description: UI schema for Stage 3 of the Area Analysis v2 wizard — DCPR 33(11) PTC/rental scheme. Fewer inputs than 33(10): zonal FSI, share split and FSI cap all come from the regulatory_constants table via RulesRegistry.

sections.title: Plot & deductions
sections.blurb: Enter the gross plot and every deduction. Net plot updates after save.

fields.label: Named deductions (nalla, CRZ, etc.)
fields.help: Any other named deduction. Set 'include' = 1 to deduct from net plot; 0 for informational only.

sections.title: Amenity handover (Reg 14(A))
sections.blurb: Area handed over as amenity plot. Reduces net plot but may not reduce FSI.

sections.title: Scheme parameters
sections.blurb: 33(11) uses zonal FSI + share split from the DCPR constants table. Only the loading factor is user-adjustable.

fields.label: Loading factor
fields.tip: Ratio to convert tenement carpet → BUA. Default 1.15 for PTC/rental housing.
